preferred_direction: prefer Rx-style stream composition over imperative callback chains
reason: reactive composition makes retry backoff and reconnection policies easier to layer without tangling transport code

preferred_direction: pass immutable DTOs and immutable event snapshots through the stream pipeline
reason: immutable values reduce accidental shared-state bugs during retries buffering and fan-out

preferred_direction: model retries as higher-layer operators or policies around the stream rather than hidden transport behavior
reason: keeps retry explicit testable and replaceable

preferred_direction: offer adapters that fit Dart Stream and Rx-oriented usage rather than a single mandatory abstraction
reason: lets consumers adopt the library in different runtimes while keeping one event model

preferred_direction: keep raw transport separate from decoded reactive pipelines
reason: preserves a narrow transport contract while still allowing rich stream orchestration above it
